Always write your answers in a new file on folder Answers with a proper name.
Always wrap math statements in single $ if short (e.g., $E=mc^2$) or double $$ if long and important (e.g., $$\int_a^b f(x)dx$$).

If on a part of the answer you want to write a full mathematical statement or proof, use the following markdown structure:

>[!Proposition] Title of the example or exercise
> Body of the statmenet
> ....
>>[!Proof]-
>> 1. Step 1 of the proof
>> 2. Step 2 of the proof
>> ...

If you are just explaining a concept or giving a short answer, you can use normal markdown without the special blocks.
